reviews.comment: I honestly don't understand why his rating is so high. He seems like a nice guy, but he can't teach. His lectures felt like a waste of time. We were never actually given a course schedule. The only way you'd know a quiz was happening the next class was if mentioned it class prior or he forgot to, sending an email the night before at like midnight.

Lectures are normal and helpful, however if you want to be ready for the pop quizzes work a little ahead in the week in review. The tests are basically like the quizzes and the week in review helps a lot. Overall a very helpful and knowledgeable professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very passionate about subjects he teaches and cares for the student's well being within the class. He is very open to questions and super accessible outside of class and after lectures. He loves explaining the material so do not be afraid to ask questions. He grades fairly and gives helpful homework and week in reviews to prepare for exams.

Lectures aren't the most engaging, but he uploads completed notes which are very informative. His practice problems and homework also prepare you perfectly for the quizzes and exams. He overall made 308 my easiest class of the semester.

He is clearly very smart and care about his students. He provided good notes, extra practices, and simulations to help you visualize the concept. However, he did tend to upload things like homework assignments and grades kinda late, which made it hard to study for the quizzes ahead of time. Also, his lectures were hard to follow for me personally

His lectures aren't the most engaging, but the slides themselves are really informative. His practice problems and homework also prepare you perfectly for the quizzes and exams. Made 308 my easiest class this semester.

Grading of assignments, quizzes, and tests tended to be late so if you assume you know what you are learning about it might come as a surprise that it might not be up to the standards for the professor. Material was amazing though it was not my style of learning, I like simple and clear explanations rather than extensive ones.

His lectures are pretty clear and easy to follow, he shows all his work for all problems and makes it easy to understand. He is also very chill and caring, he gives you lots of practice problems and will answer all your questions.

Overall, really chill and understanding professor. He gives reasonable tests however they are worth 80%, making the class very test heavy. He also sometimes posts HW only a couple days before due date, but overall a great prof to take for diff eq.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Difficult class in general but shelvean did a good job teaching it. homeworks have python which has no application to exams unfortunately. exams are graded a bit harshly but given plenty of feedback so you know what you got points off for. lectures are hot and cold, some are good and engaging but they can also be boring and not useful.

Chill prof, clear lectures, super open to questions and willing to help his students. Often gives you quiz answers if you ask for help. Exams were fair and the week-in review was a great study tool. Accent wasn't an issue. However, he didn't always post hw on time and covered new topics right before we were tested on them. Overall, would recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Kapita is one of the best professors I have had at this University. He is accessible very often during office hours, and he understands what he is talking about in lecture. He prepares simulations for class so that he can demonstrate visually what we are learning, and he is very capable of explaining any of the topics in new ways to help you.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Overall a really good prof. If you attend lectures and do the homework/quizzes you will be fine. His reviews are also pretty similar to the exams so definitely do those. He also tries his best to help his students out any way he can. Take him if you get the chance!

Dr. K has plenty of detailed, readily available material he is more than willing to share, and he often attempts to lighten the time to solve problems by allowing use of code on homework's or creating questions such that you only need to half finish the answer for full credit on tests. Overall great, and made differential equations my easiest class
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Love this guy! Best math prof I've had since Schrader and Yershova. GOAT.

He is a great professor! Be prepared though because he goes slowly and his accent can be hard to understand. I went to the MLC and they help you get 100's on all of your WebAssigns. The class is mostly a review of high school math but still, make sure you prepare for the exams. This class is both manageable and doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Kapita is very passionate about his courses. He often makes python apps that display the concepts in a playground-esque manner, which really got me to be interested in the class. Has somewhat of an accent and sometimes mumbles but overall a great professor. He DOES post solved out slides so there's that.
Very fair exams, quizzes, and homework, the WIR decently cover what is going to be on the exams and there are no surprises

Dr. Kapita is a great professor who cares that his students understand the materials. He has helpful online simulations of the content we learn that he makes himself. He also hosts the week in review which is very helpful. The only thing is your grade is basically all from the tests so you can't really have a bad test day. Highly recommend!

Professor Kapita is hard to follow along in lecture and doesn't post notes in a timely manner, meaning I'm often left sitting in class without notes to write on wondering what in the world is even going on. While Professor Kapita is far from the worst professor I've had, you can do yourself much better than him.

Kapita really wants his students to understand the material, he uses online simulations and proofs for intuition. Quizzes are open note/person. Exams are easier than most. The most annoying thing is how he makes homework due at 5:30 pm on Fridays with only 3 days to do it. Overall, I'd say that he's one of the better Diffeq profs

He was a good professor who would do his best to teach the concepts. I personally felt as though he would complicate simple problems which would confuse me, so I would have to reteach myself in easier ways. However, the practice questions are similar to exams so take advantage of those! He really does want the best for his students. I recommend him
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a great professor! His teaching style makes the concepts very easy to understand! It's simple to get an A as long as you complete all the assignments and study for the exams.
gives almost no homework

I struggled with his accent quite a bit, but he cares a lot for the subject, and is very accessible outside of class. There is multiple extra help options, if you need them. I have never been very good at math, but the subject itself is a lot of algebra 2. If you do you assignments, and go to class you should be fine.

Dr. Kapita is very nice, this class just sucks in general. There are two quizzes each week an individual one on Monday and a group quiz on Friday. His tests are half multiple choice and half free response. 
Dr. Kapita is always willing to work with his students and is pretty easy to meet with after class, for office hours or at another time.

Kapita is a very good professor! The workload can be pretty heavy, as the entire class is lecture notes from beginning to end (rarely left early), and attendance was tracked at random using iclickers. But, unlike some other professors, Kapita rarely gives in class quizzes, and makes it all take home or group work! Overall I recommend!!

Kapita is a good professor and I believe it was his first year teaching 147. Lecture and Note intensive class, but empty and filled notes provided. Jokes with class often and his accent isn't that bad. Weekly quizzes aren't too bad as long as you review notes. Office hours are very good and he is open to questions.
A bit hard to understand due to accent but he's very caring and understanding and wants his students to succeed.
Dr. Kapita was very knowledgeable and had great lecture notes that were available online. He was very helpful during office hours and week-in-reviews. 5-star professor, would take again.

Lectures were good and we were always well-prepared for the exams. Main complaint would have been the weekly quizzes, as sometimes the notes did not prepare us to complete them. Regardless, quizzes are open-note and can be done with others. Kapita is a good choice for differential equations.

Hes solid. Lectures are OK. Gives good feedback when asked questions in class or office hours. Gives weekly "quizzes" that usually are just homework. Sometime the quizzes are in class, but they are open note and collaborative. Python assignments are easy. He posts both empty and complete notes. Exams are only FRQ so he will give partial credit.

Class is not mandatory and the tests aren't too bad. His lectures aren't too bad, and with the materials provided the tests are pretty straightforward. He also hosted the week in review which was very nice.Shoutout shelvy.

Dr. Kapita is a great choice for 308! Exams were very straightforward and were much easier than quizzes. He led the week in review which was very helpful to reinforce concepts and prepare for exams. Very accessible outside of class as he regularly holds office hours and responds to emails quickly.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very nice professor, and his accent isn't that bad to understand. His lectures are not always the best, but they are useful to attend most of the time. His FRQ exams are easy as he gives generous partial credit and there's no "gotcha" questions; just study as usual and you'll pass easily. He's accessible outside of class and answers all questions.

Kapita is probably the best prof for diff eq. His tests are all FRQs and gives lots of partial credit. Weekly quizzes are basically the homework, and grading is light. Python assignments are very easy as he gives all the code. Lectures can be confusing at first, but he answers questions well and ran the week in review which was very helpful.

He was super nice and understanding and he truly wants you to do well in his class. Although the course itself is not organized very well, if you utilize the resources and go to him for help, he is more than willing.
He is a super nice guy but hard to understand. He does answer emails quickly which is nice.

I took him this semester and he was AMAZING. He answered most of my emails to him within 30 minutes if sent at reasonable times. He was very kind in office hours and was always willing to help me out. He does have a thick accent, but he is a good teacher and understood the material well. If you put in the effort,  you will do amazing in his class!
Very thick accent and very hard to understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy
